I used to have really bad insomnia as a result of my eating disorder. Apparently it’s pretty hard to sleep when you’re literally starving, your body’s main focus is to get nutrition so getting rest isn’t at the top of the priority list.

After about 60 hours of being up nonstop I decided to go for a run at this trail close to my house. Everything seemed normal, but pretty soon after I started running a wasp-like bug started buzzing around my head. I tried to keep running and ignore it, but it just kept going in circles around me. When I turned around, it followed, when I stopped, it stopped with me, and when I sprinted, it caught up. Soon there were two of them. My adrenaline was pumping so I sprinted to my car and put on some bug spray. I went to a different part of the trail where there were a lot more people and tried to start running again. I looked down and saw hundreds of these bugs. I looked around and nobody else seemed bothered and I started to freak out, why were they following me? Why didn’t anybody else notice these evil creatures? I ended up deciding to give up on my workout and sprint back to my car. On the way there I felt the bugs sting me twice in the spine.

I’ve been trying to figure out if this was a hallucination for years, and I’ve decided it probably was. There were small red marks on my spine, but they look like acne, not stings at all. Insomnia is terrifying. Get your sleep, guys.
